note: Progressive microcephaly and spastic quadriparesis are hallmark core postnatal features reported in initial cohorts (e.g., 7/7 in Falik Zaccai et al.), while fetal ultrasound anomalies are being identified in prenatal cohorts.

evidence.text: Seven patients presented at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay, demonstrating 100% presence of these core findings in this cohort.

source.title: Phospholipase A2-activating protein is associated with a novel form of leukoencephalopathy
source.quote: Herein, we have identified a unique form of leukoencephalopathy in seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay.
